name: The Boy Who Loved Crows
source:
A chance meeting between a down-to-earth farmer and an idealistic young boy can change how both view the world around them.

[From the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240714234120/https://games.renpy.org/game/tbwlc]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
一名脚踏实地的农夫偶然遇见了一位怀抱理想的少年，这次相遇或许会改变两人看待周遭世界的方式。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240714234120/https://games.renpy.org/game/tbwlc]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
